Engineer enterprise infrastructure environments including Windows Server, Enterprise Linux, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle Database, networking, storage, virtualization, and cloud services. Build, optimize, and support realistic enterprise lab environments utilizing Microsoft Azure, AWS, VMware ESXi/vCenter, Hyper-V, and related enterprise technologies. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Strong scripting skills with PowerShell/JSON required and experience with Python, Bash, or similar automation languages.
